doc: control_envelope: extra cycles of a BSSY/BSYNC reconvergence region (reconvergence v2 protocol: per-region residual over the body's SASS stalls, affine in control_path_count). Bound to the BSSY that opens the region: the converter attaches the region facts (control_path_count, sequential_region_count, control_selector_present) to the opening BSSY record (convert/control_flow.py); the engine applies the value as a floor on the warp's next issue after the bound instance (InstanceTiming.control_envelope -> WarpState::control_floor).
